event: Explicit permitted-dates decision recorded; remaining defaults proposed for human confirmation
source_quote:
Yes. Allow any valid calendar date, including past dates, today and future dates.
Due dates are optional. Do not reject a date simply because it is in the past.

recommendations_unconfirmed.text: Proposed, unconfirmed: an unfinished task is overdue only when its due date is earlier than today on the user device. Show an explicit Overdue label with a subtle warning color; today is not overdue. Preserve existing list ordering.

Proposed, unconfirmed: due dates are calendar dates without a time, interpreted against the device local calendar, with no UTC conversion that shifts the selected day. Reject impossible calendar dates, preserving the previous saved value and showing a clear validation message.
Proposed, unconfirmed: completing a task retains its due date but removes overdue emphasis. Reopening the task restores overdue indication when the retained date is before today.

Proposed, unconfirmed: date editing and clearing use existing autosave behavior. Clearing removes the optional date. Cancel discards only unsaved or invalid drafts; previously autosaved changes remain saved.

next_human_question: Do you confirm the proposed defaults together: overdue only for unfinished tasks dated before device-local today, text plus subtle warning color without reordering; date-only local-calendar interpretation with invalid dates rejected while preserving the saved value; completed tasks retain dates without overdue emphasis, restored on reopening; and edit/clear follows existing autosave and cancel-draft behavior?
test_execution: Not run; no application implementation changes.
